migration.reason: All consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

notes: Root administration and data-integration URLs must never default to a child surface the user cannot read. They resolve to the first child route permitted by the existing effective Core permission set, and protected children remain suppressed while the redirect is pending. Create-only import access is also represented in the main Data Integration navigation because it has a valid generic creation landing route. No role-name inference or backend authorization change is introduced.
